status_note: The six targeted projections (collectLaneSizes source acceptance and mask filtering, mode-0 split success, mode-2 default-lane backward rejection, post-apply IR and count, rule_onceperfunc second-pass skip, clearLanedAccessMap timing) are byte-identical MATCH against the locked 12.0.4 oracle. Four branches remain uncovered or unavailable under ACTION-LANEDIVIDE-RESIDUAL-0001, so the fixture-level B2 status is UNTESTED.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Funcdata &data is mutated across calls (setLanedRegGenerated, clearLanedAccessMap, LaneDivide IR rewrites); count lives on the Action itself and apply returns 0; Rugra externalizes count via take_count_delta into ActionState.count
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: mode 0..3 with allStorageProcessed break; lanedMap walked in VarnodeData::operator< order; per-storage [beginLoc(sz,addr), endLoc(sz,addr)) in VarnodeCompareLocDef order with a bounds-recalculating restart after each successful split
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: count zeroed by perform, +1 per successful processVarnode then immediate return true; per-storage allVarnodesProcessed reset on success / cleared on failure; allStorageProcessed aggregated after the storage loop
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: checkLanes iterated ascending by lane size (bitmask LanedIterator); collect candidates restricted by allowedLane(sizeBitMask>>size&1); map keys ordered by space index, offset, then bigger-size-first

analysis_options.funcdata: One BfdArchitecture shell per case over immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl (main_free for the piece success, main_init for the INT_MULT failure); no followFlow and no Action pass; one synthetic BlockBasic per case; lanerecords replaced in-place with whole sizes 4 (mask 0x4) and 16 (mask 0x100); ActionLaneDivide driven through the real Action::perform state machine twice per success case with a hand-queued register-space storage re-check between the performs
analysis_options.placeholder_construction: Success case: CPUI_PIECE 4-byte unique root over 2-byte constants with SUBPIECE readers at offsets 0 and 2; failure case: CPUI_INT_MULT 16-byte unique root over 16-byte constants with one SUBPIECE reader at offset 0
analysis_options.case_matrix: collect candidate acceptance from SUBPIECE outputs and PIECE min-input; collect filtering against the whole-size-16 record; processVarnode mode-0 success and mode-2 default-lane backward rejection; apply IR rewrite and count; rule_onceperfunc second-perform skip with a surviving re-queued storage; clearLanedAccessMap timing on both success and failure
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG and TYPEPROP_DEBUG absent
analysis_options.action_status_mirroring: protected count/status are read through a ProbeLaneDivide subclass on the C++ side and through the public ActionState companion on the Rust side; perform return values, counts and statuses are projected as plain integers

collect_lane_sizes_sources_and_filter.covers: SUBPIECE descendant output sizes and PIECE min-input sizes registered when allowedLane accepts (piece case, lane 2 accepted by the whole-size-4 record) and rejected when the mask lacks the bit (failure case, size 2 vs whole-size-16 mask 0x100)

process_success_piece_split.covers: mode 0: first successful LaneDivide::doTrace over the ascending lane-size list applies the split and returns true (count=1, four 2-byte COPY ops replace the PIECE/SUBPIECE cluster)

process_failure_default_mode_reject.covers: modes 0/1 with empty collected lanes and mode 2 default pointer-size lane 8: backward trace rejects CPUI_INT_MULT, zero IR mutation, no count

apply_ir_and_count.covers: full block-level op/var projection before/after apply including createIndex, sizes, spaces, def/descend edges, alive/dead counts, plus the Action count channel (perform returns the accumulated count)

rule_onceperfunc_second_pass_skip.covers: after the first perform the executor status ends at 16 (status_end); a hand re-queued register-space storage survives the second perform, whose return is 0 with unchanged count and stable IR

laned_map_clear_timing.covers: clearLanedAccessMap runs at the end of apply on both the success and failure paths (map 1 entry -> 0 in both cases, after setLanedRegGenerated gated any new registration)

mode1_downcast_subpiece_terminator.covers: mode 1 allowDowncast=true SUBPIECE terminator acceptance was not exercised: both fixtures' SUBPIECE readers consume exactly one lane so the downcast branch never fires

multi_varnode_bounds_restart.covers: the recalculate-bounds restart (cc:606-607) only fires with a single varnode per storage in these cases; two SSA versions at one storage address would exercise the restart walk

multi_storage_map_iteration.covers: each case registers exactly one laned storage; multiple storages per function (VarnodeData::operator< iteration order driving the mode loop) are not projected here (the lanedMap ordering itself is covered by lanedivide_infra_1204)

mode2_pointer_size4_normalization.covers: coreaction.cc:566-569 keeps a 4-byte pointer size as lane 4; the locked x86-64 oracle always reports pointer size 8, so the ==4 keep-branch has no oracle observation under this architecture

branches.detail: mode 1 SUBPIECE downcast terminator acceptance (allowDowncast=true with a reader smaller than one lane) never fires in the fixture readers
the beginLoc/endLoc recalculation restart (coreaction.cc:606-607) needs two SSA versions at one storage address
several laned storages per function with the VarnodeData::operator< mode-loop interaction; the map ordering alone is covered by lanedivide_infra_1204
the keep-pointer-size-4 branch of the mode-2 default lane has no x86-64 oracle observation (pointer size is always 8)
